newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hardie sees postive U.S. housing market.
newsitem.headline: Hardie sees postive U.S. housing market.

text.p: Australian building materials group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday the immediate outlook for housing construction and renovation in the U.S. is positive.

"This is due to modest inventory levels, firming house prices, a relatively attractive interest rate environment and favourable economic conditions," James Hardie said in its latest investor update report.
James Hardie said new housing in the United States as well as renovation activity will remain steady at current high levels or decline marginally.
James Hardie, which mainly supplies fibre cement to the U.S. market, said fibre cement demand was largely driven by substitution rather than in response to overall market growth.
Demand for fibre cement roofing and interior lining products is also growing steadily in the U.S., James Hardie said.

"Although growth is expected to be much more modest than for siding, developments in fibre cement technology and the introduction of new products for these segments could expand market opportunities significantly over the next three to five years," it said.
